summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor for CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-4, reported an Underwriting Agreement dated October 14, 2026 with MUFG Securities Americas as representative of the underwriters, covering $1,333,122,000 aggregate principal of asset-backed notes secured by auto-loan receivables. Anticipated issuance is on or about October 21, 2026, under an SF-3 shelf filed July 25, 2025. A final prospectus dated October 14, 2026 details the class structure, including $253,787,000 Class A-1 and multiple Class A-2 tranches. This is a routine ABS securitization takedown, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and spreads.
